purpose: Teach: もどっ/はさん/つくし/心中/少く/いれる/前もって/申しわけ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが旅から家にもどって来られると安心した
lines.en: Gran, when your father would come home from a trip in those early days, I felt so safe.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Voice settles into memory like sitting down after a long day. Measured pace, each phrase deliberate but not heavy. Trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、本にしおりをはさんで読まれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and he'd tuck bookmarks into his books as he read them, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle affirmation, almost sing-song in its tenderness. Slight upward tilt on the question. Voice warm with the pleasure of shared memory. Not correcting, completing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが春につくしを摘まれた
lines.en: Gran, in those days, your father would pick tsukushi shoots in the spring.
lines.style: Quieter this time. The memory flickers — more specific, more fragile. Slow pace. Slight hesitation before 'spring,' as if reaching back. Soft and wondering.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、心中、家族を一番大事に思われてたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: In his heart, he always put family first, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Knowing, steady voice. Not a question seeking answer but one seeking acknowledgment. Warm recognition of a quiet truth. Slight emphasis on 'first.' Closing gently.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは食欲が少くなる時もあった
lines.en: Gran, in those days, your father would sometimes lose his appetite.
lines.style: Voice drops almost to a whisper. Vulnerable moment — revealing something unsaid, something he carried. Soft attack. Pause before continuing, like choosing to trust her with this.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お茶をご自分でいれるのがお好きだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He loved making his own tea, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Bright shift. Voice lifts slightly — a small, particular kindness she notices and brings forward. Still warm but lighter. Gentle uplift at the question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが旅程を前もって組まれた
lines.en: Gran, when he was younger, your father would plan his trips carefully in advance.
lines.style: Contemplative, slow. Each word carries weight. Voice has a quality of piecing something together — order, care, intention. Exhale at the end, like finishing a thought.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ご家族にも「申しわけない」と丁寧に仰ってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he'd always say 'I'm sorry' so politely to the family, wouldn't he, dear?
lines.style: Voice warm with bittersweet recognition. Slight catch on 'sorry' — not emphasizing but honoring the word. Closing note tender and knowing. Question feels like a soft embrace.
